authorization: Owner requested revised stages 3/4 and initiation of the main analysis, 25 September 2026
assay: Mouse lung epithelial RiboTag immunoprecipitation, QuantSeq; day 7 after bleomycin, per published Fig. 1K
excluded: Axum8 is the antibody control and is not a vehicle control for KIRA8. Whole-lung libraries are not independent animals.
inference: Treatment association in epithelial ribosome-associated RNA; no DATP-specific, fate, cell-composition or epigenetic attribution from this assay alone
multiple_testing: BH across all retained genes; secondary gene-set family separately

qc.raw_read_QC: Not reprocessed; alignment and RNA integrity metrics unavailable in deposited count table

gene_sets.selection_reason: Predefined TGF-beta and general/terminal unfolded-protein-response axes; no selection by observed DE
gene_sets.method: limma voom + CAMERA; estimated inter-gene correlation; allow.neg.cor=FALSE
gene_sets.missing_symbols: Report and exclude exact lookup failures without silent alias repair
gene_sets.multiple_testing: BH across eligible sets in this three-set family; no corroboration independent of source study

threshold_interpretation: FDR <0.05 denotes statistical evidence under the specified model, not biological validity or independent replication
